name: old-host core + desktop, a newly published desktop update refused
comment: Held by scripts/verify-selection-updates.py (`task selection:updates`) against the RELEASED headless host (v0.1.0) running
the released desktop provider as its bundled provider, with a newly published desktop update installed per user. The
update states first-party-selection-v1, which that host does not supply, so it is refused INCOMPATIBLE before it loads:
the contract is the original core + desktop one, unchanged, and the bundled desktop provider is the row that runs.
